about.page_description: The story behind Engineer Interview Hub: 180+ curated interview questions, AI mock interview, voice answers, and bilingual support — built independently by Wood.
about.hero_subtitle: 180+ curated questions paired with AI mock interviews and voice-based answers to sharpen your engineering interview skills
about.project_body_1: While preparing for software engineering interviews, I couldn't find a platform that combined high-quality questions, instant AI scoring, and a full mock interview experience — all in one place. So I built one. From the question bank and admin CMS to the AI integration and voice-based interview flow, everything was independently designed and developed.
about.project_body_2: Building this project gave me deep hands-on experience with Nuxt 4's SSR architecture, Supabase Auth and Row Level Security, OpenAI GPT-4o's streaming API, and Tailwind CSS v4. Going fully bilingual with i18n meant every feature had to work seamlessly in both Traditional Chinese and English.
about.feature_questions_desc: Frontend, Backend, Data Engineering, and DevOps — 26 categories and counting
about.feature_ai_desc: Full interview simulation powered by gpt-5.4-nano, with voice interaction and a detailed performance report
about.feature_bilingual_desc: Fully available in Traditional Chinese and English — switch anytime, seamlessly
about.feature_voice_desc: Speak your answers like in a real interview — powered by OpenAI speech-to-text
about.author_bio: A frontend engineer who transitioned from the MIS field, passionate about building practical projects deeply integrated with AI. Engineer Interview Hub is my personal contribution to improving software engineers' interview preparation — hoping to help more people land their dream offer.
about.contact_desc: Feel free to reach out for question suggestions or if you spot any errors in the interview content.
